name: Crimson Harvest: Into the Maze
source:
"You have been selected for the annual Great Harvest. Your fate awaits you soon. Thank you for your cooperation."

You take control of Echo, a young woman born into a world where the Soulless reign with a mighty fist. Nothing is more sure in this world than one thing; the Fruitful, those in their 50s, are sent to the Great Harvest and are never seen again. 

But Echo seemed to be the exception to that rule and is now placed in an impossible situation.

She has only one goal in mind: survive. 

[From [url=https://unknown-minnow.itch.io/crimson-harvest-into-the-maze]itch.io[/url]]
